title.en: Unit 5 Notes — Maintenance of Water Supply Mains
title.gu: યુનિટ 5 Notes — Water Supply Mains ની Maintenance

body.en:
Why maintenance is necessary:

  • Limit leakage, wastage and non-revenue water.
  • Maintain pressure, continuity and fire-flow capability where required.
  • Prevent contamination by intrusion through leaks and cross-connections.
  • Reduce pipe failures, traffic disruption and emergency repair costs.

Keep maps and asset records, monitor flows and pressures, inspect valves and chambers, identify recurrent bursts and plan rehabilitation. Prioritise vulnerable consumers and inform them before shutdowns.
body.gu:
Maintenance ની જરૂરિયાત:

  • Leakage, wastage અને non-revenue water ઘટાડવા.
  • Pressure, continuity અને જરૂરી fire-flow capability જાળવવા.
  • Leaks અને cross-connections દ્વારા intrusion થી contamination અટકાવવા.
  • Pipe failures, traffic disruption અને emergency repair costs ઘટાડવા.

Maps અને asset records રાખો, flows અને pressures monitor કરો, valves તથા chambers તપાસો, વારંવાર bursts ઓળખો અને rehabilitation યોજના બનાવો. Vulnerable consumers ને પ્રાથમિકતા આપી shutdown પહેલાં જાણ કરો.

body.en:
Prevention and detection:

  • Select pressure-rated material and correct jointing; provide appropriate bedding, corrosion protection and thrust restraint.
  • Control excessive pressure and pressure surges; maintain valves and avoid uncontrolled operation.
  • Use district metering, minimum-night-flow analysis, acoustic surveys and pressure monitoring to identify suspected leaks.
  • Compare metered supply with consumption; distinguish physical losses from billing or meter errors.

Repair sequence: locate and isolate the main, provide safe excavation and traffic controls, prevent contaminated water entering, repair using approved fittings, and pressure-test, flush, disinfect and sample as required before return to service. Maintain records and inform users. Do not rely on a visible dry surface to rule out leakage.
body.gu:
Prevention અને detection:

  • Pressure-rated material અને યોગ્ય jointing પસંદ કરો; યોગ્ય bedding, corrosion protection અને thrust restraint આપો.
  • Excessive pressure અને pressure surges નિયંત્રિત કરો; valves જાળવો અને uncontrolled operation ટાળો.
  • Suspected leaks ઓળખવા district metering, minimum-night-flow analysis, acoustic surveys અને pressure monitoring વાપરો.
  • Metered supply ને consumption સાથે સરખાવો; physical losses અને billing અથવા meter errors અલગ કરો.

Repair sequence: Main શોધી isolate કરો, safe excavation અને traffic controls આપો, contaminated water નો પ્રવેશ અટકાવો, approved fittings થી repair કરો અને service શરૂ કરતાં પહેલાં જરૂરી pressure-test, flushing, disinfection તથા sampling કરો. Records રાખી users ને જાણ કરો. દેખાતી surface સૂકી હોય એટલે leakage નથી એવું ન માનો.

body.en:
Conservation measures:

  • Repair leaks promptly and maintain meters and pressure management.
  • Use efficient fixtures and avoid unnecessary running water.
  • Harvest rainwater where safe and permitted; maintain roofs, first-flush arrangements and storage.
  • Reuse appropriately treated wastewater for approved non-potable purposes with separate, clearly marked networks.
  • Use awareness, fair tariffs and water audits; protect sources and recharge areas.

Reuse requires treatment matched to exposure and local regulations; never connect non-potable lines to drinking-water systems without approved backflow protection.
body.gu:
Conservation measures:

  • Leaks ઝડપથી repair કરી meters અને pressure management જાળવો.
  • Efficient fixtures વાપરો અને બિનજરૂરી વહેતું પાણી ટાળો.
  • સલામત અને મંજૂર હોય ત્યાં rainwater harvesting કરો; roofs, first-flush arrangements અને storage જાળવો.
  • મંજૂર non-potable uses માટે યોગ્ય treated wastewater અલગ અને સ્પષ્ટ ચિહ્નિત network માં ફરી વાપરો.
  • Awareness, યોગ્ય tariffs અને water audits વાપરો; sources અને recharge areas નું રક્ષણ કરો.

Reuse માટે exposure અને local regulations મુજબ treatment જરૂરી છે; approved backflow protection વગર non-potable lines ને drinking-water system સાથે કદી ન જોડો.

title.en: Numerical 5.1 — Daily water loss from leakage
title.gu: Numerical 5.1 — Leakage થી daily water loss

body.en:
Given: A continuous leak is measured at 0.5 L/s. Estimate volume lost in 24 hours if the rate stays constant.

Step 1. Convert one day to seconds.

Time = 24 × 60 × 60Time = 86400 s

Step 2. Calculate lost volume.

Loss = leak rate × timeLoss = 0.5 × 86400Loss = 43200 L

Final answer:

Loss = 43.2 m³/day at the assumed constant rate.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: સતત leak 0.5 L/s માપવામાં આવે છે. Rate સ્થિર હોય તો 24 hours માં ગુમાવેલું volume ગણો.

Step 1. એક દિવસને seconds માં ફેરવો.

Time = 24 × 60 × 60Time = 86400 s

Step 2. ગુમાવેલું volume ગણો.

Loss = leak rate × timeLoss = 0.5 × 86400Loss = 43200 L

અંતિમ જવાબ:

ધારેલ constant rate પર loss = 43.2 m³/day.
